confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge. No live menus, listings, or booking pages were checked, and no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable. Beer, cocktail, wine glass, and the 3-star hotel are least certain because alcohol and hotel tax rates have changed in recent years and the July 2026 level is extrapolated from older knowledge. Cocktail and wine glass are set at roughly twice the beer anchor because direct local bar-price knowledge is weak. Hotel anchors assume typical taxes and service charges are included. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a direct anchor. The basis is general South Asian tourist-city pricing, with Colombo-specific judgement on local restaurant levels, alcohol taxation, and guesthouse and hotel tiers, applied to a July 2026 window with no seasonal adjustment.
